title: YouTube Content Search 패널 연결 문제 해결 및 캐시 버전 도입

changes.description: Static Path 등록 추가 - private_hacs 패턴 구현 (hass.http.async_register_static_paths)
캐시 버전 시스템 도입 (파일 수정 시간 mtime 기반, v{mtime} 형식) - HACS 업데이트 시 캐시 자동 무효화
panel.js 파일 생성 로직 추가 (inline JS를 파일로 변환하여 외부에서 로드)
새 파일 생성 - private_hacs panel.py의 _write_panel_js_sync() 패턴 구현 (fetch + HTML 파싱 + 컴포넌트 정의)

issues_fixed: 사이드바에 아이콘은 나왔는데 주소가 https://local로 나오고 연결이 안됨
HACS 자동 /local/... 경로 사용으로 인한 커스텀 Static Path 무시 문제

title: Enable service-only setup
changes: Disable panel and HTTP routes
Load entry credentials and apply options
Validate actions and use shared HTTP session
Fix Cast serialization and videos.list metadata
Add translations, contract tests and Korean documentation
validation: Eight mocked HA tests pass; real HA/Cast not tested

title: Persist local playlists across HA restarts
changes: Add atomic HA Store persistence and startup restoration
Serialize merge/delete operations and verify writes
Import legacy runtime states only when storage is absent
Retain saved playlists on unload and block stale repository writes
Keep service names and inputs unchanged; defer UI
Update usage docs and add persistence regression tests
validation: 17 file-backed HA contract tests passed; actual HA Store/Cast not tested

title: Add optional Media extractor playback mode
changes: Add playback_mode cast/media_extractor with Cast default
Delegate selected YouTube video URL to media_extractor.play_media
Check optional service availability before consuming search quota
Declare optional after_dependency and document video stream requirements
validation: 21 mocked HA contract tests pass; actual stream extraction and device playback not tested

title: Expose safe YouTube API error reason codes
changes: Parse legacy errors.reason and structured details.reason/status
Allowlist constant diagnostic codes; omit messages, URLs and unknown strings
Keep HTTP status when error bodies are malformed or non-JSON
validation: 23 mocked contract tests passed, including safe diagnostic output; live HTTP 400 cause remains unconfirmed

title: Focus playback on Google Cast
changes: Remove Media extractor branch, playback_mode field and optional dependency
Retain persistent local playlists and safe API error diagnostics
Remove experimental playback tests and document removal of playback_mode from automations
validation: 19 mocked HA contract tests passed; actual Cast playback not tested

title: Expose YouTube search playback to Assist LLMs
changes: Add native Assist llm.py tools and a selectable legacy API fallback
Delegate to the existing search_play service with conversation context
Recheck exposed available players before every call and redact backend errors
Support legacy dictionaries and modern ToolResult responses
Document setup and update project structure
validation: 23 mocked HA tests passed; syntax and whitespace checks passed; live HA discovery and Cast playback not tested

title: Restrict Assist and search_play action targets to Google Cast
changes: Share entity registry platform checks between Assist discovery and action execution
Filter action selector by media_player domain and cast integration
Reject other integrations and unregistered targets before YouTube API calls
Recheck Cast identity at tool execution and document restrictions
validation: 25 mocked HA tests, syntax, UTF-8 and whitespace checks passed; live HA selector and Cast playback not tested

title: Always register a selectable YouTube LLM API
changes: Remove native-platform availability condition from API registration
Provide YouTube Content Search as an independent tool provider
Disable automatic contribution to Assist to prevent duplicate tools
Test provider listing, unload, reload and options updates; correct setup documentation
validation: 26 mocked HA tests and syntax, UTF-8, JSONL and diff checks passed; live HA provider UI not tested

title: Prepare YouTube Content Search 1.0.1
changes: Increment custom integration manifest version from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1
Update README and HACS repository information for the selectable Cast-only YouTube provider
Correct outdated setup/version notes and point to the development changelog
validation: Manifest JSON and documentation references checked; no runtime behavior changed
